title: Blocks of Symmetric-Group Centralizer Algebras
statement: For the centralizer algebra $kS_n^{S_\ell}$, are all blocks represented by products $ef$ of a block idempotent $e$ of $kS_n$ and a block idempotent $f$ of $kS_\ell$?
